data_kind: Published synthetic subscription benchmark based on KKBOX listening data
sample_note: The public repository includes 20 artificial input profiles for live inference. They have no observed labels. Evaluation metrics use the original full chronological test set.
limitations: Synthetic subscription labels: accuracy does not establish real newspaper conversion performance.
No user identifier is supplied: repeated users cannot be grouped or audited across splits.
A chronological date split is used; the precise original label-generation and observation horizon remain unverified.
No randomised offers or offer prices: this model estimates label propensity, not offer uplift or revenue.
Source metadata reports licence Unknown. Downloaded example records and the original source archive are kept local and excluded from Git and container builds.
Negative measurements are imputed with training medians; feature caps are learned on training data only.
